# Independent visual QA — issue #66

**Issue:** [Link sign-in methods to one account with explicit dual proof](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/66). **Reviewer:** GPT-6.1 Sol, High reasoning effort. **Date:** 2026-10-25. **Verdict:** changes recommended; 0 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 1 LOW. Review only; no product/spec/Git/GitHub mutations.

## Snapshot, purpose and evidence boundary

Reviewed HEAD `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`, the fresh issue snapshot in `../contracts/issue-66.md` (closed, no comments), active Flow 05, current adoption/reference/token contracts and the current screen/service source. Existing dirty documentation, skills and evidence were preserved. `git diff --name-only -- frontend` was used to confirm this reviewer left frontend source unchanged. Only this directory was written.

User job: add a second, potentially different-email sign-in method to the same account, prove both identities, understand the consequence, and deliberately commit. The UI must support correction and safe unresolved outcomes without merging accounts or claiming production proof.

Fresh browser evidence was produced with installed Playwright Chromium, isolated contexts, Vite `--mode mock --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4366 --strictPort`, Windows, muted audio and fake media flags. Normal app journeys used **service-seeded synthetic identities** in a fresh default IndexedDB namespace, then visible form controls for the entire linking journey. Seeding called `identity.google(purpose=registration)` for a Google-only account or `registration.start/verify` for a password account. No external provider, mailbox, account or physical media was used. RU fixtures explicitly aligned the synthetic account's saved locale before entering the screen. A preliminary mismatched-locale seed produced a stale-revision notice; that diagnostic is not asserted as a natural user defect.

The pending, conflict and unknown screenshots use the repository's existing `e2e/harness/auth-state-visual.html?screen=link&scenario=...` harness, which injects deterministic service responses into the actual App/screen. These demonstrate frontend response handling, not real conflict/security/atomicity behavior. Provider operations remain local simulation. Existing reports were not used as fresh acceptance evidence.

Artifacts: [metrics.json](metrics.json), [screenshot-manifest.json](screenshot-manifest.json), [capture-log.json](capture-log.json), [capture-log-supplement.json](capture-log-supplement.json), capture scripts in this directory. Twenty manifest screenshots plus one exploratory probe PNG were freshly captured. Every screenshot cited below was opened and visually inspected, including source PNGs. Full-page captures deliberately reveal overflow; screenshot width can exceed the configured 390 px viewport.

## Reference comparison

Read Clean button source at `../affect-ui-clean-light/source/components/button/Clean/button-clean.md.txt` lines 289–376 and OTP source at corresponding `otp-input/Clean/otp-input-clean.md.txt` lines 596–665. Visually inspected Button Light `01-initial.png` and OTP Light `03-invalid-code.png`. Those relative source paths are actually under `_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light/`; the exact absolute root is `D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/evidence/affect-ui-clean-light/source/components/`.

| Reference / adaptation | Fresh actual result | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Button md: 28 px height, 13/20 Medium, radius 6, dark primary; phone 48 px and 16/24 per Dubbed adaptation | Desktop proof/commit actions measure 28 px, Mabry Pro 500, 13/20; phone proof/commit actions 48 px and 16 px | Source density reproduced; independent size critique below |
| OTP: 40×44 preferred visible cells, 8 px gap, radius 8, real input 16 px | Six cells and one real code input; active value survives wrong-code rejection | Positive; invalid-state mapping is incomplete |

## Findings

### QA-66-01 — MEDIUM — Google-current proof button overflows the phone in both languages

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-07, AC-VIS-01, Flow05 responsive presentation.

**Reproduce:** use a Google-only local account; enter Account linking; enter a different candidate email and password; Continue; inspect current Google proof at 390×844. Reproduced in the actual mock app in RU, and independently in the existing EN harness.

**Expected:** full primary label and hit area fit the available column; no document horizontal scrolling. **Actual measured:** RU button x=33, width=504.39, height=48, document scrollWidth=537 versus viewport390. EN width=420.33 at x33, scrollWidth453. The button extends outside the card and right edge. At 767 and768 there is no overflow, which does not validate the phone.

**Impact:** core confirmation wording is clipped at ordinary phone width; horizontal panning is required to see it. **Cause:** verbose full-sentence CTA plus inherited single-line sizing and `.account-linking-screen__form > .ui-button { justify-self:start }`; phone rules increase target/font but do not constrain this button's width. Source: [copy and button render](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:108), [phone sizing](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.css:263).

**Recommendation:** retain explanatory sentence as help; shorten the button to an action such as Continue with Google, constrain it to the form and permit appropriate wrapping if necessary. Preserve 48 px phone targets. **Next validation:** EN/RU actual Google-current proof at320/390/767/768, full label, no scrollWidth overflow, focus ring unclipped.

![RU phone overflow](evidence/ru-phone-dual-proof.png)
![EN phone overflow; synthetic harness](evidence/en-phone-google-proof.png)

### QA-66-02 — MEDIUM — Rejected candidate code lacks field error mapping

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-06/07, AC-VIS-01, Flow05 §7.

**Reproduce:** actual Google→password linking; enter `000000` rather than the locally displayed mock code; Confirm email method.

**Expected:** code rejection is rendered beneath code entry or immediately above its active submit, with invalid input and associated accessible error. **Actual:** the red message appears above the whole two-panel stack, approximately448 px above the code input in this capture. The six entered zeros remain, which is correct, but the cells remain neutral; the real input has `aria-invalid=null`, `aria-describedby=null`. Its relationship to the error is absent. Contrast with the correctly mapped current-password error in RU/EN.

**Impact:** correction is visually disconnected from the field; assistive technology cannot retrieve the error through this input's description. **Cause:** `proveCandidate` passes invalid-code through generic `finishMutationError`; global ServiceNotice at line934; OTP invalid prop depends only on local missing-code formError at1040. Sources: [candidate error path](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:799), [invalid prop](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:1040). Flow05 §7 explicitly requires field errors beneath fields and service proof errors above the affected primary action, not above another proof block.

**Recommendation:** map typed invalid-code to code-field error and error description, keep digits, apply adopted OTP invalid appearance. Keep global notices for genuinely global failures. **Next validation:** wrong/expired/replaced code in EN/RU, field focus and screen-reader relation, preserved digits, no success before service verification.

![Actual invalid code](evidence/en-desktop-invalid-code.png)

### QA-66-03 — MEDIUM — Conflict asks for restart while retaining final submit

**Class:** confirmed frontend defect under a deterministic injected service conflict. **Affected:** AC-04/06, AC-VIS-01.

**Reproduce:** open the existing harness with `screen=link&scenario=link-commit-conflict`, then Link methods. This fixture starts with both proofs ready and returns an explicit conflict; it does not simulate real service concurrency.

**Expected:** stale intent cannot continue final submission until authoritative reconciliation/restart; the recovery action is the primary path. **Actual:** notice says “The account methods changed… Reload Account before starting again,” but the verified panels and review remain, with an enabled Link methods button. There is no local restart action. Raw metrics confirm disabled=false. The same screen properly removes submission for an unknown result, so this is a distinct branch problem.

**Impact:** contradictory guidance encourages repeated attempts with stale proof/revision context and leaves users to discover that the distant Account button is the recovery route. No unsafe backend association is claimed.

**Cause:** `finishMutationError` sets conflict without invalidating proof state; `readyToCommit` excludes unknown but not conflict, and the final button only gates busy. Sources: [error state](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:591), [ready gate](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:893), [commit button](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:1067).

**Recommendation:** suppress final submission on conflict, reconcile/reload authoritative intent/account state, offer an explicit safe Return to Account or Restart action; require new proofs where invalidated. **Next validation:** real-mock stale-revision and already-owned scenarios, count commit calls, ensure only authorized fresh intent can restore final action.

### QA-66-04 — MEDIUM — Protected identity and resource consequences are missing at the decision points

**Class:** confirmed implementation mismatch plus product clarity concern. **Affected:** AC-01/03, Flow05 §§5.3,5.4,5.6,5.7.

**Reproduce:** enter either local-mock linking direction; inspect start and unconfirmed current-method panel; complete proofs and inspect final review; commit and inspect success.

**Expected:** identify the current account being protected with permitted authoritative information, explain that both methods open its existing balance/projects and preserve the one grant, and show both methods associated at success. **Actual:** start/current proof says only Google or Email and password; it does not show the current email even though the signed-in snapshot has it. Address appears after successful proof and in the final review. The final copy says only to review two methods “before adding them to this account.” Success says both methods are linked but removes both identity rows. No retained-resource consequence appears at start, review or success.

**Impact:** a person with multiple Google/email identities cannot confirm which current account they are protecting before fresh proof, and receives little reassurance about what will happen to existing work. This is a missing explanation; actual resource loss is not alleged. Disclosure beyond the already authorized account address remains an open policy boundary and should not be invented.

**Cause:** current-method address is computed but only passed to methodView in verified/review branches; consequence copy is absent from start/review/success strings. Sources: [address](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:892), [verified-only display](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:993), [review text](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:118), [success](D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/account-linking/AccountLinkingScreen.tsx:124).

**Recommendation:** show approved current-account identity before proof, explicitly state one existing account/library/balance with no extra grant, and retain the two method identities in success. Avoid exposing foreign-account details or asserting unreturned amounts. **Next validation:** different-email EN/RU screenshots at start/review/success, no foreign identity disclosure, resource statements backed by mock snapshots and later production checks.

### QA-66-05 — LOW — Compact desktop action density is a poor fit for the final security decision

**Class:** requirement/design flaw; recommendation for owner consideration, not a claimed accessibility violation. **Affected:** desktop visual contract and task clarity.

**Measured fact:** final Link methods is101.45×28 px, Mabry Medium13/20; RU final action152.72×28. The account-linking column is840 px wide. Completed proof cards remain full-sized above a third review card that repeats the same two identities. In the RU1440×700 interaction, final action is still below the viewport (y786 in current scrolled state); full-page coordinate is1114. In EN, the full-page commit coordinate is likewise1114. Phone uses48 px actions correctly.

**Interpretation:** source compactness is reproduced, but there is no dense data work here that benefits from tiny buttons. The large empty/tall cards and duplicated confirmations consume attention while the consequential action is the smallest high-priority element. The body is quiet and readable, so this is hierarchy and efficiency, not an automatic WCAG failure.

**Recommendation:** consider a flow-specific larger desktop final/proof target (e.g.36–40 px with readable14–16 px labels) while keeping Mabry, dark primary and Clean radii; collapse confirmed proof panels into concise status rows and bring review + decision into a shorter block. This would require an explicit design-contract adjustment for action sizing, not a silent implementation change. **Next validation:** compare1440×900/700 EN/RU with a first-time user; measure time to locate final action, keyboard route, complete identity visibility and no clipping.
